bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative observation and reflection by students prompting a text-to-image generative model to visualize their future identities, specifically noting how the model defaults to specific phenotypes for prompts like 'Asian', 'Indian', or 'pretty girl'.

Qualitative discussion during a constructionist learning workshop where students and instructors observed stereotypical gender representations in text-to-image outputs (e.g., noting that occupations like 'doctor' default to a man, while 'pretty girl' defaults to a blonde female).

Qualitative exploration through an identity expression activity where students used prompt engineering to counter default stereotypical depictions of age when generating images of their future selves.
